name: Aggregate crypto and stock market news feed from multiple sources

parameters.jsCode:
// Start a fresh buffer for this execution.
const mem = $getWorkflowStaticData('global')  // ✅ valid contexts: 'global' | 'node'
mem.x_items = []          // where we'll collect all RSS items from each batch
mem.x_topic = $json.topic // optional: remember topic ('crypto' | 'stocks') from builder

return $input.all()       // pass through

const q = $json.queries?.google ?? '(bitcoin OR crypto)'
const url = `https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en`
return [{ json: { ...$json, url } }]

parameters.content:
## README

README – Crypto/Stocks News → UI workflow

### What this does
- Collects crypto or stock-market news from CoinDesk, CoinTelegraph, Google News, and X (via xcancel.com RSS).
- Tags each item with topic (crypto or stocks).
- Filters & deduplicates items in “Code - Keywords Filter”.
- Bundles everything in “Code - Array bind” as:
```
{ topic, items: [ { id, source, kind, title, url, publishedAt, matchedKeywords, summary, html, media[], topic } ] }
```
- Sends the items to your backend via “HTTP Request - Send to localhost”.

### How to use
- Use either “Schedule Trigger” (interval runs) or “Webhook” (run-workflow) as entry.
- Open “Init RunConfig” to set default topic (crypto | stocks), platforms (coindesk / google / cointelegraph / x) and optional tickers.
- Update “HTTP Request - Send to localhost”:
- Change the URL from http://localhost:3000/api/hooks/news to your own API endpoint.
- Either set a real x-webhook-secret header (and verify it in your backend) or remove that header completely.

If you call the Webhook node, also fix header auth: create an HTTP Header Auth credential for x-webhook-secret, or switch the node’s auth to “None” for local tests.

- To change what gets through, edit the keyword & spam lists inside “Code - Keywords Filter”.

### Original purpose

This workflow was built to transfer curated news data into a custom UI.

You can instead connect anything after “Code - Array bind” (DB, Slack/Telegram, email, etc.) and reuse the { topic, items } payload for your own use case.

Edit these places only for 90% of use cases:
```

2.URL build nodes 
3. Keywords Filter lists
4. HTTP Request URL/headers.
```

## Section 1 – Triggers & Run Config
This section controls how the workflow starts and what it should fetch.

## Section 2 – Fetch & Tag News from Sources
This section decides which sources to use and pulls news from each of them.

## Section 3 - Merge and normalize All Items
This section normalizes metadata and merges all sources into one unified stream.

## Section 4 – Filter, Deduplicate & Build Payload → Send to Backend
This section prepares the final dataset and sends it to your app or UI.
